name: dsh-deepseek-picker-filter
description: Restrict the dsh model picker to the DeepSeek models an external patrol last confirmed usable, while always keeping paid/official providers and non-patrol channels (e.g. Volcengine Ark) visible in a fixed order after codearts, and the current selection; an expired whitelist keeps filtering with the last known list instead of exposing every model.
